facts.claim: Celestyal Journey (Celestyal Cruises): Entered service 1994; 55,819 GT; 1260 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 220 m length; ex-Statendam / Pacific Aria class.
Celestyal Journey is a cruise ship completed in 1994 and initially sailed for Holland America Line as Ryndam.
In 2023 she was resold to Celestyal Cruises and renamed Celestyal Journey.
In December 2023, Celestyal Journey was chartered by the German-based cruise line, Phoenix Reisen.

catalogSpecs.description: Formerly AIDAaura, now sailing Greek Islands and Mediterranean routes.
